title: crepis commutata
intro: Crepis commutata, commonly known as rosin root or yellow hawk's beard, is a perennial plant species belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The rosin root is also known for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and diuretic properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of urinary tract issues and menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of Crepis commutata include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
